outcome: No verified credit-free, PC-independent direct Germany queue solution found. Current direct responses remain blocked; no no-missed-queue guarantee is justified.

sources_reviewed.finding: Guesses Queue-it customer IDs and emits a candidate for any non-404 response, including HTTP errors. No Germany banner verification. Not adopted; third-party code not executed.
Requires BROWSERLESS_WS_URL and checks US/UK/CA only. Basic text matching lacks German regional confirmation. Does not establish an unlimited free DE solution.
Chrome extension observes the local active tab and queue data received by that browser. Does not supply an independent public DE queue endpoint or PC-independent service.
Browser extension opens a local browser tab for its checks. Incapsula-resource presence is listed as an indicator but is also present on security pages. Not a standalone cloud Germany proof.
Provider describes shared UK/US/Germany queue activations and a possible German-only banner. Archive is derivative evidence, not a live first-party regional confirmation.
Provider specifies free polling every 30 minutes, Pro every five minutes, and no guarantee of detecting every drop. Does not meet immediate free direct monitoring.
Provider says previous queue-position network trick stopped exposing position in late October 2025. Its guide is not verification of any present direct endpoint.
Official guidance: a queue may be traffic control and does not necessarily indicate a product launch or available stock. No public queue-status API documented on this page.

validation_limits: Direct test observed a security page, not an actual German queue activation.
Synthetic tests confirm routing and deduplication only, not upstream access or real detection latency.
No hidden endpoint guessing, cookie replay, CAPTCHA solving or proxy rotation was used.
Manual credit diagnostics still exist as opt-in tools and were not run.
